# Orchestration Test Fixtures

Synthetic, non-secret test fixtures for RUN-01 pipeline orchestration and recovery.

Contents:
- Synthetic source configurations and raw postings
- Synthetic candidate profiles with approved evidence
- Synthetic search policies and availability policies
- Synthetic mock Salesforce sync responses and errors
- Synthetic model responses and pending error envelopes

All fixtures use strictly artificial identifiers, mock URLs, and synthetic candidate facts.
No real candidate data, live API credentials, or production Salesforce credentials are stored here.
